reading: Collins English Dictionary has named mogging its word of the year.
Used playfully, the expression describes outperforming or upstaging another person or thing.
The term gained currency beyond its younger users in 2026, when its use rose by 210%, having spread among Generations Z and Alpha both online and in everyday speech.
Collins managing director Alex Beecroft says lexicographers, specialists who research words for dictionaries, examine how frequently expressions occur.
They also analyse recurring contexts to identify linguistic trends, or broader developments in how people use language.
Beecroft interprets the choice as evidence that successive generations leave their mark on language.
Mogging is often traced back to AMOG, an acronym formed from Alpha Male of the Group.
The term has also been associated with bodybuilding forums in the mid-2010s.
Far from being invariably insulting, the term can function as either a playful put-down or a compliment, depending on context.
Its comparative meaning most often concerns physical appearance, with one person appearing more impressive than another.
It circulates in looks maxxing communities, online groups whose members exchange advice on maximising their physical attractiveness.
To reflect changes in English in the United Kingdom, Collins draws on varied material, including social media.
Its 2025 choice was vibe coding, the practice of creating an app or website by describing it to artificial intelligence rather than manually writing programming code.
Another expression on this year’s ten-item list is ghost job, referring to a position advertised by an employer with no intention of appointing anyone.

vocabulary.definition: Attracting more attention or admiration than someone else, making their contribution or presence seem less impressive.
Became more widely used or recognised, especially when referring to an expression or idea.
Specialists who research words and their meanings to produce or revise dictionaries.
Broader developments in how people use language, identified through recurring evidence.
Influence something in a distinctive way that becomes recognisable.
Connected through historical evidence or accounts to an earlier form or origin.
Connected in accounts or understanding with something, without necessarily having originated there.
Uses available material, knowledge or evidence to inform its work.
Without having a particular action as an intended outcome, rather than merely failing to achieve it.

entries.ja: ほかの人よりも多くの注目や称賛を集め、その人の貢献や存在感をそれほど印象的ではないように見せること。
entries.ko: 다른 사람보다 더 많은 관심이나 찬사를 받아 그 사람의 기여나 존재감이 덜 돋보이게 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 比别人吸引更多关注或赞赏，使对方的贡献或存在显得不那么突出。
entries.es: Atraer más atención o admiración que otra persona, haciendo que su contribución o presencia parezca menos destacada.
entries.pt-BR: Atrair mais atenção ou admiração do que outra pessoa, fazendo com que a contribuição ou a presença dela pareça menos impressionante.
entries.fr: Attirer davantage l’attention ou l’admiration qu’une autre personne, ce qui rend sa contribution ou sa présence moins remarquable.
entries.de: Mehr Aufmerksamkeit oder Bewunderung als jemand anderes auf sich ziehen, wodurch dessen Beitrag oder Anwesenheit weniger beeindruckend wirkt.

entries.ja: 特に表現や考えについて、以前よりも広く使われたり知られたりするようになったこと。
entries.ko: 특히 표현이나 생각이 이전보다 더 널리 쓰이거나 알려지게 된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 变得使用得更广泛或为更多人所知，尤其用于描述某种表达或观念。
entries.es: Pasó a usarse o reconocerse más ampliamente, especialmente al hablar de una expresión o idea.
entries.pt-BR: Passou a ser mais amplamente usado ou reconhecido, especialmente quando se trata de uma expressão ou ideia.
entries.fr: Est devenu plus largement utilisé ou reconnu, notamment lorsqu’il s’agit d’une expression ou d’une idée.
entries.de: Wurde in weiteren Kreisen verwendet oder bekannt, besonders in Bezug auf einen Ausdruck oder eine Idee.

entries.ja: 辞書を作成したり改訂したりするために、言葉とその意味を研究する専門家。
entries.ko: 사전을 만들거나 개정하기 위해 단어와 그 의미를 연구하는 전문가들.
entries.zh-Hans: 研究词语及其含义，以编写或修订词典的专家。
entries.es: Especialistas que investigan las palabras y sus significados para elaborar o revisar diccionarios.
entries.pt-BR: Especialistas que pesquisam as palavras e seus significados para elaborar ou revisar dicionários.
entries.fr: Spécialistes qui étudient les mots et leurs sens pour élaborer ou réviser des dictionnaires.
entries.de: Fachleute, die Wörter und ihre Bedeutungen erforschen, um Wörterbücher zu erstellen oder zu überarbeiten.

entries.ja: 繰り返し見られる証拠から把握される、人々の言語の使い方における全体的な変化の傾向。
entries.ko: 반복해서 나타나는 근거를 통해 파악되는, 사람들이 언어를 사용하는 방식의 전반적인 변화 양상.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过反复出现的证据识别出的人们使用语言方式的整体发展趋势。
entries.es: Cambios generales en la manera en que las personas usan el lenguaje, identificados mediante indicios que se repiten.
entries.pt-BR: Mudanças gerais na maneira como as pessoas usam a linguagem, identificadas por meio de evidências recorrentes.
entries.fr: Évolutions générales dans la manière dont les gens utilisent la langue, repérées grâce à des indices récurrents.
entries.de: Übergreifende Entwicklungen im Sprachgebrauch, die anhand wiederholt auftretender Belege erkannt werden.

entries.ja: 何かに独特の影響を与え、その影響が分かるようになること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 뚜렷한 방식으로 영향을 주어 그 영향을 알아볼 수 있게 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 以独特的方式影响某事物，使这种影响变得可以辨认。
entries.es: Influir en algo de una manera distintiva que llega a ser reconocible.
entries.pt-BR: Influenciar algo de uma maneira própria, que passa a ser reconhecível.
entries.fr: Influencer quelque chose d’une manière particulière qui devient reconnaissable.
entries.de: Etwas auf eine unverwechselbare Weise beeinflussen, sodass dieser Einfluss erkennbar wird.

entries.ja: 歴史的な証拠や記述を通じて、より古い形や起源とのつながりが示されていること。
entries.ko: 역사적 증거나 기록을 통해 더 이전의 형태나 기원과 연결된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过历史证据或记述，与更早的形式或起源建立了联系。
entries.es: Vinculado mediante pruebas o relatos históricos con una forma anterior o un origen.
entries.pt-BR: Ligado, por meio de evidências ou relatos históricos, a uma forma anterior ou a uma origem.
entries.fr: Relié, à travers des preuves ou des récits historiques, à une forme antérieure ou à une origine.
entries.de: Durch historische Belege oder Berichte mit einer früheren Form oder einem Ursprung in Verbindung gebracht.

entries.ja: 記述や人々の理解の中で何かと結び付けられているが、必ずしもそこから生まれたとは限らないこと。
entries.ko: 기록이나 사람들의 이해 속에서 어떤 것과 연결되어 있지만, 반드시 거기에서 비롯되었다고 할 수는 없는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在记述或人们的理解中与某事物有联系，但不一定起源于那里。
entries.es: Relacionado con algo en relatos o en la manera de entenderlo, sin que necesariamente se haya originado allí.
entries.pt-BR: Ligado a algo em relatos ou na maneira como é entendido, sem necessariamente ter se originado ali.
entries.fr: Mis en relation avec quelque chose dans les récits ou dans la compréhension qu’on en a, sans nécessairement y avoir son origine.
entries.de: In Berichten oder im allgemeinen Verständnis mit etwas verbunden, ohne zwangsläufig dort entstanden zu sein.

entries.ja: 利用できる資料や知識、証拠を、自らの仕事の参考や根拠として使うこと。
entries.ko: 자신의 작업에 참고하거나 근거로 삼기 위해 이용 가능한 자료, 지식 또는 증거를 활용하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 利用现有的材料、知识或证据，为自身工作提供参考或依据。
entries.es: Utiliza material, conocimientos o pruebas disponibles para orientar su trabajo.
entries.pt-BR: Usa materiais, conhecimentos ou evidências disponíveis para orientar seu trabalho.
entries.fr: Utilise les ressources, les connaissances ou les éléments de preuve disponibles pour guider son travail.
entries.de: Nutzt verfügbare Materialien, Kenntnisse oder Belege als Grundlage für die eigene Arbeit.

entries.ja: ある行動を実行するつもりがない状態。単にその行動を実行できなかったという意味ではない。
entries.ko: 특정 행동을 할 의도가 없는 상태로, 단순히 그 행동을 하지 못했다는 뜻은 아니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 并不打算采取某个特定行动，而不只是未能做到。
entries.es: Sin tener el propósito de realizar una acción determinada, y no simplemente sin haber logrado realizarla.
entries.pt-BR: Sem ter o propósito de realizar determinada ação, e não apenas sem ter conseguido realizá-la.
entries.fr: Sans avoir pour objectif d’accomplir une action donnée, et non simplement sans avoir réussi à l’accomplir.
entries.de: Ohne die Absicht, eine bestimmte Handlung auszuführen; es geht also nicht bloß darum, dass ihre Ausführung nicht gelungen ist.
